rows.feature: Error card inline retry (.s-error-retry, ActionBarPrimitive.Reload) re-issues a real request, not just a re-render
rows.expected: Clicking the inline retry control re-invokes the real adapter for this message (same live mechanism ActionBar.tsx's own Reload uses) — the error card genuinely clears because message.status transitions away from error, not because the DOM node was cosmetically hidden. Known documented deviation: the fixture's turnIndex 2+ has no scripted crash-recovery content, so the second attempt lands on the honest empty unscripted() fallback rather than a populated 'recovered' response — that is expected here, not a bug.

error card visible before retry, text="Something went wrong
